media.title: Photo library
media.intro: Real photos of your products and projects, plus your logo. Posts use these photos: the system only crops them to Instagram's format, gently corrects light and contrast, and can add your logo. The product itself is never changed.
media.filesHint: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or HEIC (iPhone). You can select several at once.
media.descriptionHint: One sentence; the agents use it when writing the post (e.g. "White built-in wardrobe with handleless doors").
media.logoHint: The logo marked "Used on posts" goes in the bottom-right corner of post images. Keep other versions (e.g. the round profile crop) here too.
media.noLogo: No logo uploaded yet. Choose type "Logo" when uploading.
media.focalHint: Click on the most important part of the photo: crops keep it in frame.
media.previewAlt: How the post image will look
media.previewHint: This is exactly the image that will be published. Save to update it after changes.
media.enhance: Gentle light and contrast correction (colours stay the same)
media.deleteConfirm: Delete this photo? Posts that already used it are not affected.
media.sourceHint: Own work and licensed photos can be published. Renders are published as visualisations, never as finished projects. References (e.g. saved from Pinterest) are for inspiration only: they are never published, and edits made with someone else's product stay references.
media.editingLong: The AI edit is running. This usually takes under a minute; the page refreshes by itself.
media.approved: Approved: posts may now use this image
media.approveHint: Check that the product looks right and nothing odd was added.
media.notPublishable: This image can't be published yet (reference, or an AI edit waiting for approval).
media.aiSubjectHint: e.g. "the wardrobe" (helps every edit keep it intact)

roster.title: Your team
roster.intro: Each agent has a job, a schedule and reports to the Team Lead; the Team Lead reports to you every morning.

duties: Runs the team meeting every Friday: asks each agent, decides, brings you goals and a week plan
Reports to you every morning: done, market, goal progress, today's plan
Suggests posts and campaigns you can start with one click
Turns your instructions into work and splits it across the team
Watches competitors' Instagram and finds new competitors on the web by itself
Reads what your customers ask in comments
Searches the web for demand, popular models, colours and local events
Writes a report with evidence and post ideas; answers in team meetings

media_analyst.schedule: As soon as you add photos
duties: Names, tags and describes every photo
Groups photos into products
Finds the best framing and flags quality problems
Writes three different caption options per post
Rewrites them from your corrections in plain words
Uses the brand's voice, terms and hashtags
Checks every caption against the brand rules and forbidden words
Checks spelling, claims and platform limits
Sends weak options back for a rewrite

visual_editor.schedule: When a photo has an edit recipe
duties: Improves quality, removes objects, changes background or colour
Every edit waits for your approval
Publishes approved posts to Instagram and Facebook on time
Never publishes anything without your approval
